save_object_repre: save a FeatureBasedObjectRepre instance with 3D vertices, feature vectors, and camera metadata to a .pth file
load_object_repre: load a FeatureBasedObjectRepre from a .pth file with optional field filtering and device placement
get_object_repre_dir_path: get the file system directory path for storing an object representation given base dir, type, dataset, and lid
convert_object_repre_to_numpy: convert all torch tensors in a FeatureBasedObjectRepre to numpy arrays and return a new instance
FeatureBasedObjectRepre: create a FeatureBasedObjectRepre dataclass to store 3D object vertices, feature vectors, templates, and camera models
